Vikram S.: Quick follow-up from the 03/18 tail-latency postmortem. We've got a couple of recurring patterns (KV hot-shard + slow scale-up). Need owners and a decision on SLO handling while fixes land.
Holly P.: I can own the autoscale policy and alerts. Plan: add burst tokens, shorten scale-up cooldown to 20s, and add a staging-only alert for an ops buffer SLO. ETA 48h.
Tess R.: Ill take the runtime side (hot-shard mitigation + eviction heuristics). ETA ~72h for staged rollout and perf runs. Ill add per-shard counters so we can verify regressions.
Vikram S.: On SLOs: proposal is to keep the public/customer SLO at 200ms, but create an internal ops SLO of 280ms for two weeks to avoid burning error budget during the rollout. Public dashboard gets an incident annotation that points to the postmortem. Thoughts?
Holly P.: Strong preference for not touching customer-facing SLOs. Internal ops SLO + dashboard flag sounds reasonable. We should also update the runbook to include the new autoscale thresholds.
Tess R.: Agreed. Ill include the runbook link in the PR and add trace annotations for the incident window so the QA team can replay.
RemoteCI Bot: Incident 2026-03-18 | error budget impact: 4.2% | current p95: 312ms | postmortem: https://go/redwood/incident/2026-0318
Vikram S.: Action list (add to postmortem ticket): Tess -> runtime PR + perf validation (3d), Holly -> autoscale + staging alert + dashboard tile (2d), Vikram -> canary plan + rollback criteria (1d). Canary to start at 5% traffic if perf numbers look good.
Holly P.: Draft alert for staging (ops-only):
```
alert: OpsBufferedP95
expr: service:inference_p95_ms > 280
for: 5m
labels: {severity: "page"}
annotations: {runbook: "https://go/redwood/runbooks/kv-hotspot"}
```
Pushing to staging dash now.
Tess R.: Runtime draft PR: https://git.redwood/runtime/pulls/2077 - includes eviction tuning and shard counters. Perf job shows ~18% p95 improvement on synthetic workloads.
Holly P.: Infra PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/1459 - burst token + cooldown change. Staging tile: https://dash.redwood/s/ops/p95-ops-buffer. Ready for canary after runtime merges.
Vikram S.: Canary checklist: 1) update internal SLO docs + annotate public dashboard, 2) canary = 5% traffic, 3) rollback if p95 > 350ms for 10m OR error-rate delta > 0.5%. Scheduling tentative canary 09:30 UTC tomorrow.
Tess R.: No blockers. Will finish merge prep tonight and post perf artifacts to the ticket.
Holly P.: Ill notify CS about the public dashboard annotation and include the incident link.
Vikram S.: Thanks all. Well reconvene after canary to decide whether to keep the ops buffer for 14 days or revert to normal SLO math. Logging closure items in the postmortem ticket now. :thumbsup:
